items.summary: The Central Bank of the UAE launched an AI initiative in collaboration with HSBC and local banking institutions.

items.title: Gulf Bank organizes youth workshop on artificial intelligence
items.summary: Gulf Bank is organizing a youth workshop focused on artificial intelligence.

items.title: Kuwait Finance House launches advanced AI solutions in its call center
items.summary: Kuwait Finance House has deployed advanced artificial intelligence solutions in its call center operations.

items.title: NBK launches Microsoft Copilot across all divisions, pioneering AI integration
items.summary: NBK has launched Microsoft Copilot across all divisions as a pioneering AI integration initiative to empower employees.

items.title: National Bank of Kuwait launches Microsoft Copilot, first generative AI solution
items.summary: National Bank of Kuwait has launched Microsoft Copilot as its first generative AI solution.

items.title: Mashreq appoints Xi Liang as Head of Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Xi Liang will lead Mashreq's AI strategy and embed AI capabilities across customer experience and operational efficiency. The appointment signals a dedicated AI leadership role with a focus on ethical and explainable AI.

items.title: UAE Central Bank sets up 'sovereign AI' company with tech firm Presight
items.summary: The Central Bank of the UAE established a sovereign AI company in partnership with technology firm Presight.

items.title: Central Bank of the UAE and Presight launch AI finance venture for UAE's digital payments
items.summary: The Central Bank of the UAE and Presight launched an AI-powered financial venture to enhance UAE's digital payment infrastructure.

items.title: QIIB and Visa Launch Biometric 'Click to Pay' for Seamless, Secure Digital Payments
items.summary: QIIB has partnered with Visa to launch a biometric 'Click to Pay' payment solution for digital transactions.

items.title: Boubyan Bank launches summer programme 'AI and Technology Pioneers'
items.summary: Boubyan Bank has launched a summer programme called 'AI and Technology Pioneers' for students.

items.title: QIB recognised as 'Best Consumer Bank' and 'Best Personalised Advice in Middle East' at AI in Finance Awards 2025
items.summary: Qatar Islamic Bank received awards for best consumer bank and best personalised advice in the Middle East at the AI in Finance Awards 2025 by Global Finance.

items.title: Commercial Bank awarded 'Most Innovative Use of AI Technology'
items.summary: Commercial Bank of Qatar has been awarded for most innovative use of AI technology.

items.title: Kuwait Finance House launches Fahad, Kuwait's first AI-powered virtual employee
items.summary: Kuwait Finance House has launched Fahad, its first virtual employee based on artificial intelligence technology in Kuwait.

items.title: Boubyan Bank enhances customer experience with AI
items.summary: Boubyan Bank is using AI to improve its customer experience.

items.title: FAB implements Intellect eMACH.ai Lending debt-management solution
items.summary: Intellect announced that FAB has implemented its Debt Management solution, part of the eMACH.ai Lending suite. The AI element is thin, so this is low confidence.

items.title: Boubyan Bank and Microsoft collaborate to advance artificial intelligence applications
items.summary: Boubyan Bank is partnering with Microsoft to enhance the adoption and use of artificial intelligence.

items.title: Commercial Bank partners with Ooredoo to power the future of AI
items.summary: Commercial Bank of Qatar has partnered with Ooredoo to develop AI-powered solutions.

items.title: GFH Launches Next Generation AI-Powered Chatbot Assistant
items.summary: GFH Financial Group has launched a new generation of AI-powered chatbot assistant.

items.title: RAKBANK retrieves decades of documents in minutes with Azure AI Services for compliance
items.summary: RAKBANK uses Azure AI Services to streamline compliance by retrieving historical documents in minutes.

items.title: RAKBANK uses Azure AI and Azure OpenAI to speed up KYC and power in-app assistant
items.summary: RAKBANK digitised, categorised and indexed millions of customer documents using Azure AI Services. It also launched an AI assistant in its mobile app. KYC compliance case processing time fell from 80 to 20 minutes.
items.impact: 75% less time on regulatory review; 2 million documents digitised and indexed; case time cut from 80 to 20 minutes

items.title: Salaam Gateway: DIB uses AI tools to assess Shariah compliance
items.summary: An industry feature by Salaam Gateway says DIB is using AI tools to assess the Shariah compliance of companies and financial instruments. The mention is brief, with no detail on the tools, vendor or results.

items.title: Emirates NBD pilots new AI compliance tech to reduce risks, improve payment speed
items.summary: Emirates NBD is piloting AI-powered compliance technology to reduce risks and improve payment speed.

items.title: Emirates NBD pilots AI compliance platform for payments and trade
items.summary: Emirates NBD is rolling out an AI-driven solution to strengthen compliance checks on payments and trade transactions. It aims to make payments faster, safer and compliant with global rules. It was reported alongside the bank's Q1 2025 results.

items.title: Mashreq partners with Clari5 for GenAI fraud detection platform
items.summary: Mashreq is partnering with Clari5 (a Perfios company) to launch Clari5 Genie, a GenAI-powered fraud detection and investigation platform. It uncovers hidden patterns, simulates fraud investigations and speeds up case resolution. It runs on-premise and generates case narratives for investigators.

items.title: Boubyan Bank develops AI model in Kuwaiti dialect
items.summary: Boubyan Bank has created an artificial intelligence model that operates in the Kuwaiti dialect.

items.title: RAKBANK partners with Cleareye.ai to automate trade finance with AI
items.summary: RAKBANK is adopting Cleareye.ai's AI-driven ClearTrade platform for its trade finance operations. The aim is faster processing and lower operational risk. It also automates trade-based money laundering (TBML) red-flag checks to meet CBUAE and AML/CFT requirements.

items.title: CBD CEO outlines investment in digital banking, AI and blockchain
items.summary: A Gulf News feature covers CBD's strategy. CEO Dr Bernd van Linder says the bank is investing in digital banking, AI and blockchain, with partnerships with global technology leaders enabling AI, automation and biometric authentication in its services.

items.title: ADCB launches Meedaf, a GCC financial-operations venture with AI-driven automation
items.summary: Meedaf is a venture to transform financial services operations across the GCC for banks and financial institutions. Its offerings include AI-driven automation for collections, risk assessment and regulatory compliance. It also includes blockchain-enabled fraud detection and predictive analytics.

items.title: CBD boosts AI literacy and productivity with Microsoft 365 Copilot, saving 39,000 hours
items.summary: A Microsoft customer story describes CBD's AI approach as three pillars: workplace modernisation, operational efficiency, and experimenting for the future. Copilot, prompt-a-thons and learning resources are credited with productivity gains and wider AI literacy.

items.title: Boubyan Bank launches iGTB's eMACH.ai digital transaction banking solution
items.summary: Boubyan Bank has gone live with iGTB's latest eMACH.ai digital transaction banking solution.

items.title: Commercial Bank of Dubai launches AI and Data training program with Accenture
items.summary: Commercial Bank of Dubai has launched an AI and Data training program in partnership with Accenture.

items.title: Accenture and CBD launch Data and AI training programme for employees
items.summary: Accenture, through Udacity, and CBD launched the 'CBD AI and Data for the Future' programme, which CBD describes as the first enterprise-wide data literacy programme at a UAE bank. Employees can earn Data and AI certifications, aiming to improve customer experience and operational resilience.

items.title: Visa and ADIB sign MoU on threat intelligence at World Governments Summit 2025
items.summary: Visa and ADIB signed an MoU to collaborate on an enhanced threat-intelligence solution. The aim is to integrate Visa's cybersecurity capabilities with digital payments and strengthen ADIB's cybersecurity architecture.

items.title: Saudi Fransi Capital and MIS form AI joint venture
items.summary: Banque Saudi Fransi's capital division has formed a joint venture with MIS to provide AI cloud services.

items.title: NBF hosts Knowledge Series session on harnessing AI for business
items.summary: NBF ran a Knowledge Series session on AI for business attended by more than 200 clients from NBF and other banks. It covered AI strategies and tools, data management and ethics.

items.title: D360 becomes Saudi Arabia's first digital bank with 600k customers and AI-powered financing programs
items.summary: D360, Saudi Arabia's first digital bank, has reached 600,000 customers and offers financing programs powered by artificial intelligence.

items.title: CBD hosts Microsoft Copilot 'Promptathon' to launch Copilot rollout to 800+ employees
items.summary: CBD hosted a Microsoft Copilot Promptathon with the Microsoft Innovation Hub, marking the start of a large-scale Copilot rollout to over 800 employees. Solutions built at the event were presented to CEO Dr Bernd van Linder and Microsoft UAE GM Naim Yazbeck.

items.title: ADCB unveils five-year strategy to double net profit to AED 20bn, with digital and AI transformation
items.summary: ADCB's medium-term strategy targets doubling net profit to AED 20bn in five years and higher dividends. The newsroom summary says the strategy includes a digital and AI transformation. AI content in the source snippet is thin.
items.impact: AED 20bn net profit target (not an AI-specific figure)

items.title: SAS Provides Bank Albilad with AI-Powered Real-Time Fraud Management Solution
items.summary: Bank Albilad has deployed an AI-powered real-time fraud management solution provided by SAS.

items.title: ADIB Ventures and DIFC Innovation Hub unveil Generative AI Innovation Challenge winner
items.summary: ADIB Ventures, ADIB's fintech initiative, partnered with DIFC Innovation Hub on a Generative AI Innovation Challenge. It announced the winner on 7 Jan 2025.

items.title: Future of banking is AI-driven and ADIB is ready to evolve, CEO says
items.summary: CEO Mohamed Abdelbary, who took over in October 2024, said he is relying on generative AI to turn ADIB into much more than a bank. The bank has an in-house digital lab and a team of data scientists.
items.impact: About 25% of annual cost going into technology investment

items.title: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait to Implement AI Technology to Enhance Customer Service
items.summary: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait is implementing artificial intelligence technology to enhance its customer service.

items.title: Ahlibank Qatar Launches AI to Enhance Customer Service
items.summary: Ahlibank Qatar has launched an artificial intelligence solution to improve its customer service capabilities.

items.title: QNB Group honoured with top award at Microsoft AI Tour
items.summary: QNB Group received a top award at Microsoft's AI Tour event.

items.title: Bahrain Islamic Bank First in Bahrain to Receive AI Governance Certification
items.summary: Bahrain Islamic Bank has become the first Bahraini bank to receive an AI governance certification.

items.title: "AI is a cornerstone of ADIB's strategy," says Group Chief Digital Officer
items.summary: In an interview, Fernando Plaza described AI as central to ADIB's strategy. He tied it to ADIB Ventures, which partners with fintechs and integrates generative AI to serve more than 1.3 million customers.

items.title: Emirates NBD partners with McKinsey to drive AI and advanced analytics
items.summary: Emirates NBD has partnered with McKinsey to drive AI and advanced analytics capabilities.

items.title: National Bank of Bahrain signs accord to enhance AI capabilities
items.summary: NBB has signed an agreement to enhance its AI capabilities.

items.title: Bahrain Islamic Bank Launches Shari'a AI Programme for Fatwas
items.summary: Bahrain Islamic Bank has launched an artificial intelligence programme for Shari'a-compliant fatwas.

items.title: Emirates NBD's McKinsey partnership builds AI and advanced analytics capability
items.summary: The bank partnered with McKinsey some years ago to become an AI and advanced-analytics leader, and the article says this goal has now been achieved. It is a retrospective feature.

items.title: GFH Unveils Cutting-Edge First AI Investor Mobile App at the Future Investment Initiative
items.summary: GFH Financial Group has unveiled an AI-powered investor mobile app.

items.title: Bank Muscat's call center wins award for AI initiative implementation
items.summary: Bank Muscat's contact center has been awarded for implementing artificial intelligence initiatives.

items.title: ADIB's digital chief details AI use across service, security and analytics
items.summary: Group Chief Digital Officer Fernando Plaza Lopez said ADIB uses machine-learning algorithms to identify risk and fraud. The mobile app has AI-personalised offers and chatbots. He cited GitHub Copilot, fraud detection through the ACE Command Centre and predictive analytics.

items.title: Boubyan Bank unveils innovative digital model for the future of recruitment using AI
items.summary: Boubyan Bank has introduced a new digital model that uses AI techniques to transform recruitment practices.

items.title: NBF to deploy Intellect's eMACH.ai Cloud for Wholesale Banking on Microsoft Azure
items.summary: NBF extended its iGTB (Intellect) partnership to its wholesale business, becoming the first bank in the Middle East to implement eMACH.ai Cloud for Wholesale Banking. The platform runs on Microsoft Azure and covers cash management, trade finance, corporate lending, deposits, cards, treasury and FX, giving SME and corporate clients better information visibility.
